lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in a structured grid posterior to the gill slits, forming approximately four vertical columns and three horizontal rows on the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal ridges, with circular spots located at these grid-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each showing a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the upper surface and shadowing on the lower surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin shows a high density of small, high-intensity spots along its surface, distinct in size and distribution from the larger flank spots.
